Hiver
GitHubDocs

Reliable Agents. Fast.

Fast, isolated environments with a replayable timeline of every model, browser, file, network, and tool action.

Start your first agent locallywithnpm

npm i -g @hiver.sh/cli && hiver
npm i -g @hiver.sh/cli && hiver

When agents fail, logs don’t tell the full story

Hiver replays the browser, terminal, files, network, tools, and approvals from one timeline.

Build reliable agents that do real work

Give agents a real working environment with governed files, policy-gated actions, and full replay across every run.

  • Instant runtime

    Start an agent in milliseconds, no pre-warming required. Hiver VMs resume instantly, whether it's the orchestrator or a full browser.

  • Governed workspaces

    Give agents access to files from a variety of file systems with precise ACLs: read-only, write-only, scoped by user, team, org, or workflow.

  • Policy-gated actions

    Gate network access, protect credentials, and enforce policy around every file, API, tool, and action an agent uses.

  • End-to-End replay

    Agentic observability. Replay every browser action, file change, network request, tool call, and approval across the full agent run.

Bring any agent stack

Develop locally with Claude, Codex, Copilot, browser, or your agent loop. Deploy the same code to your cloud

import express from "express";
import { query } from "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk";

const app = express();
app.use(express.json());

app.post("/chat", async (req, res) => {
  let reply = "";
  for await (const msg of query({
    prompt: req.body.prompt,
    options: {
      model: "claude-opus-4-8",
      cwd: "/workspace",
      allowedTools: [
        "Bash",
        "Read",
        "Write",
        "Edit",
        "Glob",
        "Grep",
        "WebSearch",
      ],
      permissionMode: "bypassPermissions",
    },
  })) {
    if (msg.type === "result" && msg.subtype === "success") {
      reply = msg.result;
    }
  }

  res.json({ reply });
});

app.listen(3000, () => console.log("listening on :3000"));
